summary:
- Split Offertory upgrades into two independent cards inside Sacred Temple: Consecration Rate (hourly rate with 1x|10x|MAX selector and milestones) and Offline Cap (+1h/level from 8h up to 24h cap with balanced elemental orb costs).
- Synchronized live Offertory vault progress bar, FULL badge, time-remaining countdown, WorldMap notification badge, Welcome Back offline harvest modal, and local notification scheduling with the player's dynamic Max Offline Time Cap.
- Persisted offertoryRateLevel and offertoryCapLevel permanently across run resets in StorageService and PlayGamesService Cloud Save (with legacy offertoryLevel migration and 24h banked-seconds support).
- Added localized strings in en, pt, es, and de and expanded unit/widget test coverage (461 passing tests, 0 analyzer issues).
